name: Cinch
summary: Partnership trick-taking bidding game from the All Fours family where trump 5s (Pedros) are worth 5 points each.
rules_text: Four players in two fixed partnerships use a 52-card deck. Deal 9 cards each in threes. One round of bidding clockwise from dealer's left, each bid must be higher than the last or pass; max 14. High bidder names trump. Players discard all non-trumps face down, then dealer restores each hand to 6 cards from the stock in rotation. Dealer then discards and may choose any cards from remaining stock to make 6. If forced to discard a trump with 7+ trumps, show it and it is dead. High bidder leads. Must follow trump suit if possible on trump lead; otherwise may play any card or trump. Highest trump wins trumped trick, otherwise highest of suit led wins. Points: High trump 1, Low trump 1, Jack of trumps 1, 10 of trumps 1, Right Pedro (5 of trumps) 5, Left Pedro (5 same-color) 5, total 14. If bidder makes bid, higher total scores difference; if not, opponents score 14 plus shortfall. First side to 51 wins.
rating_reason: Specific trick-taking game, hidden hands, strategic bidding and play
